summary: Compile execution briefs into tasks and continue Go execution
description: Add a validated execution brief schema and CLI support that materializes ordered work units as .go tasks, preserves compact provenance, and executes them in the same Go invocation when requested.
acceptance: A valid execution brief creates one durable task per work unit with explicit scope, acceptance, verification, and compact source provenance.
Invalid briefs fail before workflow state is mutated.
Go with execution authority materializes and runs eligible work units in the same invocation instead of stopping after task creation.
Existing intent-only Go behavior remains compatible.

evidence.summary: Implemented go-workflow.execution-brief.v1 validation, semantic work-unit task materialization, compact SHA/source provenance, and same-invocation --execute continuation. Tests prove invalid hashes fail before task creation and execution does not stop at taskification. Verification: scripts/check-linux.sh passed with Python 3.12.13; 96 tests passed; repo validate and template pairing passed; git diff --check passed. Self-reflect: process miss found — the stack lacked a durable compact boundary between advice and execution. Selfimprove applied to the execution-brief runtime/schema and canonical Go/Wayfinder contracts; verification passed.
